primitives.name: Team-Oriented EPA/WPA
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Inferred computation: orient each play's epa/wpa to the selected team (offense as-is when team possesses; negate for opponent; handle ST carefully); assign mutually exclusive facet with precedence turnover > penalty > pass/run > ST > other (exact precedence unconfirmed); sum team-oriented EPA and WPA per facet.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'EPA_{team}': 'Expected Points Added, dimensionless', 'WPA_{team}': 'Win Probability Added, dimensionless', 'T': 'Team identifier, discrete'}
primitives.assumptions: Play outcomes are independent; team orientation is binary (possession vs. opponent).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Each play contributes exactly once to total EPA/WPA per team.

layer2.mapping: Maps raw EPA/WPA to team-specific strategic impact using possession logic and precedence rules.
layer2.telemetry: Summed EPA/WPA per team across all plays.

primitives.name: Facet-Based Value Decomposition
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Ten facets (from prompt): Pass Off, Run Off, Pass Def, Run Def, Takeaways, Giveaways, Off Pen, Def Pen, Special Teams, Other.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F_i': 'Facet identifier, discrete', 'V_{F_i}': 'Value contribution of facet i, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Mutually exclusive play classification; precedence order defines hierarchy.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Each play assigned to one and only one facet based on precedence.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphism between play types and strategic categories; enables structured aggregation of EPA/WPA.

primitives.name: Win Probability Additivity
primitives.verbatim_quote: WPA sums to ≈ final WP - initial WP if each play assigned exactly once.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\text{WPA}_i': 'Win Probability Added for play i, dimensionless', '\\text{WP}_{\\text{final}}, \\text{WP}_{\\text{initial}}': 'Win probability at end/start, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Plays are non-overlapping and fully cover the game timeline.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Additive decomposition of win probability change over time.

layer2.mapping: Enables cumulative tracking of win probability shifts via play-level contributions.
layer2.telemetry: Cumulative WPA sum matches net WP change.
